input.command:
cd proofs && python3 << 'EOF'
import struct
from pathlib import Path

def check_jpeg_exif(filepath):
    """Check JPEG EXIF for AI-related content"""
    data = Path(filepath).read_bytes()
    pos = 0
    print(f"\n=== {filepath} ===")
    
    # Check for JPEG markers
    if data[0:2] != b'\xFF\xD8':
        print("Not a JPEG")
        return
    
    pos = 2
    app_segments = []
    while pos < len(data):
        if data[pos] != 0xFF:
            break
        marker = data[pos:pos+2]
        pos += 2
        
        if marker == b'\xFF\xD9':  # EOI
            trailer_start = pos
            trailer_data = data[pos:]
            if trailer_data:
                print(f"Trailer after EOI: {len(trailer_data)} bytes")
                # Check for AI keywords in trailer
                trailer_str = str(trailer_data[:500])
                if any(kw in trailer_str.lower() for kw in ['c2pa', 'firefly', 'imagen', 'dall-e', 'algorithm', 'trained']):
                    print("  ⚠️ WARNING: AI keywords found in trailer!")
                else:
                    print("  ✓ No AI keywords in trailer")
            break
            
        if marker[1] >= 0xD0 and marker[1] <= 0xD7:  # RST markers have no length
            continue
        if marker == b'\xFF\x01':  # TEM has no length
            continue
            
        if pos + 2 > len(data):
            break
        length = struct.unpack('>H', data[pos:pos+2])[0]
        segment_data = data[pos+2:pos+length]
        
        if marker == b'\xFF\xE1':  # APP1 (EXIF/XMP)
            if segment_data.startswith(b'Exif\x00\x00'):
                print(f"APP1/EXIF segment: {length} bytes")
            elif segment_data.startswith(b'http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/\x00'):
                print(f"APP1/XMP segment: {length} bytes")
                # Check XMP content
                xmp_str = segment_data.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                if any(kw in xmp_str.lower() for kw in ['firefly', 'imagen', 'dall-e', 'c2pa', 'algorithm', 'trained']):
                    print("  ⚠️ WARNING: AI keywords in XMP!")
        elif marker == b'\xFF\xEB':  # APP11 (C2PA)
            print(f"⚠️ WARNING: APP11/C2PA segment still present: {length} bytes")
            
        pos += length
    
    print("✓ JPEG structure clean")

def check_png_chunks(filepath):
    """Check PNG chunks for AI-related content"""
    data = Path(filepath).read_bytes()
    print(f"\n=== {filepath} ===")
    
    if data[0:8] != b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
        print("Not a PNG")
        return
    
    pos = 8
    while pos < len(data):
        if pos + 8 > len(data):
            break
        length = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        chunk_type = data[pos+4:pos+8]
        pos += 8
        
        if chunk_type == b'caBX':
            print(f"⚠️ WARNING: caBX chunk still present: {length} bytes")
        elif chunk_type in (b'iTXt', b'tEXt', b'zTXt'):
            chunk_data = data[pos:pos+length]
            if b'c2pa' in chunk_data or b'adobe' in chunk_data.lower() or b'firefly' in chunk_data.lower():
                print(f"⚠️ WARNING: {chunk_type.decode()} chunk with AI keywords: {length} bytes")
        
        pos += length + 4  # data + CRC
        
        if chunk_type == b'IEND':
            break
    
    print("✓ PNG chunks clean")

def check_webp_chunks(filepath):
    """Check WebP chunks for AI-related content"""
    data = Path(filepath).read_bytes()
    print(f"\n=== {filepath} ===")
    
    if data[0:4] != b'RIFF' or data[8:12] != b'WEBP':
        print("Not a WebP")
        return
    
    pos = 12
    while pos < len(data):
        if pos + 8 > len(data):
            break
        fourcc = data[pos:pos+4]
        chunk_size = struct.unpack('<I', data[pos+4:pos+8])[0]
        pos += 8
        
        if fourcc == b'C2PA':
            print(f"⚠️ WARNING: C2PA chunk still present: {chunk_size} bytes")
        elif fourcc == b'XMP ':
            chunk_data = data[pos:pos+chunk_size]
            if any(kw in chunk_data.lower() for kw in [b'firefly', b'imagen', b'dall-e', b'c2pa', b'algorithm', b'trained']):
                print(f"⚠️ WARNING: XMP chunk with AI keywords: {chunk_size} bytes")
        
        pos += chunk_size
        if chunk_size % 2 == 1:  # Padding
            pos += 1
    
    print("✓ WebP chunks clean")

# Check all files
check_jpeg_exif('label_back.jpg')
check_jpeg_exif('studio_shot.jpg')
check_png_chunks('sleeve_front.png')
check_webp_chunks('moodboard.webp')
EOF

from PIL import Image
import hashlib

print("=== Verifying image integrity ===\n")

files = ['label_back.jpg', 'sleeve_front.png', 'moodboard.webp', 'studio_shot.jpg']

for f in files:
    img = Image.open(f)
    pixels = img.tobytes()
    pixel_hash = hashlib.sha256(pixels).hexdigest()[:16]
    
    print(f"{f}:")
    print(f"  Dimensions: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]}")
    print(f"  Mode: {img.mode}")
    print(f"  Pixel hash: {pixel_hash}")
    
    # Check EXIF if present
    exif = img.getexif()
    if exif:
        # Check for suspicious tags
        suspicious = []
        for tag_id, value in exif.items():
            tag_name = Image.ExifTags.TAGS.get(tag_id, f"Unknown_{tag_id}")
            val_str = str(value).lower()
            if any(kw in val_str for kw in ['firefly', 'imagen', 'gemini', 'dall-e', 'chatgpt', 'midjourney', 'stable diffusion', 'algorithm']):
                suspicious.append(f"{tag_name}={value}")
        
        if suspicious:
            print(f"  ⚠️ WARNING: Suspicious EXIF: {', '.join(suspicious)}")
        else:
            print(f"  ✓ EXIF clean ({len(exif)} tags)")
    else:
        print(f"  No EXIF data")
    
    print()

print("All images verified!")
